# Prompts 06 — Weapons and Equipment

Spec: [art/specs/06-equipment.md](../art/specs/06-equipment.md) · **17** generation prompts · 2 constructed or blocked

Every prompt below is complete: the master style from `ART_BIBLE.md` §2 is already expanded, and the negative prompt already merges the master, category and asset negatives. Generate the **prompt** first; once it is approved, use each **variation** with that image attached as the reference. ### `EQP_WORLD_BLADE`

| | |
|---|---|
| Priority | P0 |
| Output | `art/equipment/world/blade/eqp_blade_t2_vanguard_idle_se_01@2x.png` |
| Canvas | 128 × 160 px `@2x` · pivot 64, 144 |

**Prompt**

```text
Hand-crafted isometric pixel art for a 2.5D management RPG, in the style of premium modern pixel art: crisp hand-placed pixels on a strict grid, clean readable silhouette first, soft ambient shading with limited dithering, no anti-aliasing on the outer silhouette edge. True 2:1 dimetric projection, camera fixed, viewed from above at 26.565 degrees. Grounded frontier fantasy: timber, stone, leather, iron, wool, rope. Lived-in and practical, warm and inhabited rather than heroic or ornate. Restrained palette, strong value separation between silhouette and ground. Fully transparent background. Single subject, centred, feet or footprint aligned to the ground plane. No text, no numbers, no UI, no frame, no border, no watermark, no signature, no drop shadow baked into the sprite.

Equipment layer for a character sprite: a plain straight single-handed blade with a leather-wrapped grip and a simple crossguard, tier 2 (tier 1 is plain and worn, tier 2 fitted and bound, tier 3 fine work — always by material and wear, never glow). A working tool made by a frontier smith, true to real scale against a 112-pixel hunter, no ornament. Drawn alone in the exact position it is held in a neutral standing pose facing south-east; everything else transparent. Draw it on a 128 by 160 pixel canvas, with the point where it meets the ground at pixel 64, 144.
```

All fifteen must be distinguishable at 24 by 24 pixels. tier 1 is plain and worn, tier 2 fitted and bound, tier 3 fine work — always by material and wear, never glow. Lay out 15 panels in 3 rows of 5, each panel 96 by 96 pixels, separated by 16 pixels of empty space, in this order, left to right and top to bottom: 1) a plain straight single-handed blade with a leather-wrapped grip and a simple crossguard; 2) a two-handed maul with a heavy iron-banded head on a long haft; 3) a tall recurve hunting bow of laminated wood with a plain grip; 4) a plain wooden stave taller than a person, iron-shod at the foot, no crystal; 5) a round timber-and-hide shield with an iron boss; 6) a hand-held focus: a brass lens in a leather-bound frame; 7) a simple open-faced iron helm with a leather lining; 8) a boiled-leather cuirass with iron fittings; 9) a folded length of heavy practical robe cloth with a rope belt; 10) a pair of iron-backed leather gauntlets; 11) a pair of cloth hand wraps; 12) a pair of leather-and-iron greaves; 13) a pair of worn soft travel boots; 14) a small carved bone charm on a cord; 15) a small cast-iron sigil disc.
